mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm (asset_id, type, description, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{type}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT alarm_id, asset_id, type, description, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, is_deleted FROM alarm WHERE alarm_id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT alarm_id, asset_id, type, description, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, is_deleted FROM alarm WHERE is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC
